body:
`bake_navigation_mesh` calls `_bake_finished`, which calls `set_navigation_mesh`, which calls `update_gizmos`.  
Just from looking at the code, this for-loop should not be necessary…

```suggestion
```

The bake_navigation_mesh() is only called for the first region with a unique navmesh, not for any other region that shares the same navmesh as it would trigger "this navmesh is already baking" errors. So this is done so that all the regions update their debug because they would not receive a callback. Maybe it should be filtered to only call for regions that were not baked to not update the debug twice on them.
This seem small enough to be on stack ? Why do you need memnew ?

This is kind of wasteful, as you probably doing allocations here for no good reasons. could you instead have thread assign an Enum , and then GUI can query the enum, and to display it have a static function that give the correpsonding string ?

Do you mean just module internally here for the bake task?

It would be imo too much hassle to get this enum to the GUI and creates unwanted dependencies with module specific values. Using a module internal const to look up the string when needed sounds fine.
I meant exactly what you did ! 👍

```suggestion
	"None",
```

Is connected to change suggestion below in `NavMeshGenerator3D::get_baking_state_msg`
When I added that "Unkown" there was no enum. The enum key is NONE so imo this String shoud stay empty.
Probably even want : ` String bake_state_msg;` to avoid some unecessary parse call in the constructor.

You're right, "None" fits better (updated the suggestion). After all, if `baking_navmeshes.has(p_navigation_mesh)` is `false`, the navmesh is not being baked.  
You can disregard this suggestion. It's just that, a suggestion. Personally, I like to keep the strings in one place and elsewhere only use the enums+vector (if it makes sense in the code context, which it does here imo).  
Though it might be worth considering to change the string `"Unknown"` in line 242 to `"None"`. After all, the navmesh is not baking. So _no(ne)_ baking state.

That NONE will be what is displayed by Labels when no other state is available. I rather keep that an empty string. There is no value for a user in seeing a "None" or "Unknown" and I dont really want to check every String just in case it could be not empty.
